cues.en: Given the success of SVD with the Netflix Prize, it's not surprising that a lot of research since then has focused on building upon SVD for other specific tasks, or trying to improve it further.
cues.zh: 考量 SVD 在 Netflix Prize 的成功，後續很多研究，專注於把 SVD 擴展到其他特定任務，或進一步改善它，並不意外。

cues.en: You can find recent papers on all of these variants out there.
cues.zh: 可以找到這些各種變形的近期論文。

cues.en: I'll call out a few that are more interesting.
cues.zh: 我挑幾個比較有趣的介紹。

cues.en: Factorization Machines are worth a look, as they are well suited to predicting ratings, or predicting clicks in recommender systems.
cues.zh: 分解機，也就是 Factorization Machines，值得研究，因為很適合在推薦系統中預測評分或點擊。

cues.en: It's the same general idea as SVD, but a bit more general purpose, I'd say.
cues.zh: 大致概念與 SVD 相同，但我會說它更通用一些。

cues.en: It can handle sparse data without trying to shoehorn itself into the problem, like SVD does.
cues.zh: 它能處理稀疏資料，不必像 SVD 那樣，勉強把自己套進問題中。

cues.en: I'm calling attention to it because Amazon's SageMaker service in AWS, offers Factorization Machines as a built-in algorithm, so it's something that's easy to experiment with on very large data sets in the cloud.
cues.zh: 特別介紹它，是因為 AWS 的 Amazon SageMaker 服務，把分解機當成內建演算法，因此很容易在雲端，對大型資料集進行實驗。

cues.en: The only real downside is that it only works with categorical data, so you have to work a little bit harder at preparing your data to work with it.
cues.zh: 唯一真正的缺點，是只適用於類別資料，因此要更費力準備資料，才能使用。

cues.en: We'll revisit factorization machines a couple of times later in the course.
cues.zh: 課程稍後會再談幾次分解機。

cues.en: There are also variants that are specifically for recommending series of events, like the next things you're likely to watch or click, given your immediate history.
cues.zh: 也有專門推薦事件序列的變形，例如根據最近歷史，推薦接下來可能觀看或點擊的東西。

cues.en: In neighborhood-based methods, we talked about translation-based recs doing this, but here in the model-based section, we have tools such as timeSVD++ or Factorized Personalized Markov Chains,
cues.zh: 鄰域式方法中，談過平移式推薦能做這件事；模型式方法中，則有 timeSVD++ 或分解式個人化馬可夫鏈等工具，

cues.en: that can tackle the same sorts of problems.
cues.zh: 能處理相同類型的問題。

cues.en: Probabilistic Latent Semantic Analysis, or PLSA, is something a team I once ran experimented with once, and the early results we're promising.
cues.zh: 機率式潛在語意分析，簡稱 PLSA，是我以前帶領的團隊曾實驗過的方法，初步結果很有潛力。

cues.en: You can use it to extract latent features from the content itself.
cues.zh: 可以用它，從內容本身擷取潛在特徵。

cues.en: For example, you could apply PLSA to movie titles or descriptions, and match them up with users in much the same way PCA works.
cues.zh: 例如，對電影名稱或描述套用 PLSA，再像 PCA 那樣，與使用者配對。

cues.en: Content-based methods like this aren't likely to do very well on their own, but combining this with models built on user behavior data, could be a good idea.
cues.zh: 這類內容式方法，單獨使用可能不會很好，但結合以使用者行為資料建立的模型，也許是不錯的主意。

cues.en: As we've discussed before though, once you start getting into complex algorithms, often just tuning the parameters of the algorithm can produce markedly better results.
cues.zh: 不過，如前所述，演算法變複雜後，往往只要調整參數，就能明顯改善結果。

cues.en: And it turns out that SVD has several such parameters.
cues.zh: SVD 確實有好幾個這類參數。

cues.en: This gets into what we call hyperparameter tuning.
cues.zh: 這就進入所謂的超參數調整。

cues.en: It's a pretty big problem in machine learning in general.
cues.zh: 在一般機器學習中，這是個相當大的問題。

cues.en: A lot of algorithms are very sensitive to parameters such as learning rates, and often different settings for these parameters make sense for different data sets.
cues.zh: 很多演算法對學習率等參數很敏感，而且不同資料集，往往適合不同設定。

cues.en: For example, with SVD, we can adjust how many latent factors we try to extract, how many dimensions we want boil things down to.
cues.zh: 例如 SVD，可以調整要擷取多少潛在因子，也就是要濃縮成多少維。

cues.en: There's no right answer for that.
cues.zh: 沒有正確答案。

cues.en: It depends on the nature of the data you're dealing with.
cues.zh: 取決於資料的性質。

cues.en: In the surpriselib implementation of SVD, this value is passed into the constructor of the SVD model as a parameter named n_factors, and you can set it to whatever you want.
cues.zh: SurpriseLib 的 SVD 實作中，會以 n_factors 參數，把這個值傳入 SVD 模型建構子，可以自行設定。

cues.en: Similarly, you can set your own learning rate for the SGD phase with lr_all, and how many epochs, or steps, you want SGD to take with the n_epochs parameter.
cues.zh: 同樣地，可以用 lr_all 設定 SGD 的學習率，並以 n_epochs 設定 SGD 要執行多少個訓練週期或步驟。

cues.en: Hyperparameter tuning is usually a matter of just trying different values and iterating until you find the best one.
cues.zh: 超參數調整，通常就是嘗試不同數值，不斷迭代，直到找到最佳值。

cues.en: Generally it makes sense to start with the default setting, whatever that is, and then start guessing.
cues.zh: 一般先從預設值開始，不管預設是多少，再開始猜測。

cues.en: Try doubling it.
cues.zh: 試試加倍。

cues.en: Did that make it worse?
cues.zh: 變差了嗎？

cues.en: Try halving it.
cues.zh: 試試減半。

cues.en: Did that make it better?
cues.zh: 變好了嗎？

cues.en: Well then, at least we know it should be lower.
cues.zh: 那至少知道應該更低。

cues.en: Is halving too much?
cues.zh: 減半是不是太多？

cues.en: Does 3/4 work better?
cues.zh: 四分之三會不會更好？

cues.en: Basically you just keep narrowing down until you stop seeing significant gains in the quality of your results.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是不斷縮小範圍，直到結果品質不再有明顯提升。

cues.en: Fortunately, surpriselib contains a GridSearchCV package, that helps you with hyperparameter tuning.
cues.zh: 幸好，SurpriseLib 有 GridSearchCV 套件，協助超參數調整。

cues.en: It allows you to define a grid of different parameters you want to try out different values for, and it will automatically try out every possible combination of those parameters,
cues.zh: 它讓你定義一個參數網格，指定不同參數想嘗試哪些值，然後自動測試所有可能的參數組合，

cues.en: and tell you which ones performed the best.
cues.zh: 告訴你哪組表現最好。

cues.en: Lets look at this code snippet.
cues.zh: 看看這段程式碼。

cues.en: If you look at the param_grid dictionary we're setting up, you'll see it maps parameter names to lists of values we want to try.
cues.zh: param_grid 字典，將參數名稱對應到想測試的數值串列。

cues.en: Remember, we have to run the algorithm for every possible combination, so you don't want to try too many values at once.
cues.zh: 記得，每種可能組合都必須執行一次演算法，所以不要同時嘗試太多數值。

cues.en: We then set up a GridSearchCV with the algorithm we want to test, the dictionary of parameters we want to try out, how we're going to measure success, in this case, by both RMSE and MAE,
cues.zh: 接著建立 GridSearchCV，指定要測試的演算法、參數字典，以及衡量成功的方式，這裡同時使用 RMSE 與 MAE，

cues.en: and how many folds of cross-validation we want to run each time.
cues.zh: 還有每次要執行幾折交叉驗證。

cues.en: Then we run fit on the GridSearchCV with our training data, and it does the rest to find the combination of parameters that work best with that particular set of training data.
cues.zh: 再用訓練資料對 GridSearchCV 呼叫 fit，其餘工作由它完成，找出對這份訓練資料最好的參數組合。

cues.en: When it's done, the best RMSE and MAE scores will be in the best_score member of the GridSearchCV, and the actual parameters that won, will be in the best_params dictionary.
cues.zh: 完成後，最佳 RMSE 與 MAE 分數在 GridSearchCV 的 best_score 成員中，勝出的實際參數則在 best_params 字典。

cues.en: You can look up the best_params for whatever accuracy metric you want to focus on, RMSE or MAE.
cues.zh: 可以根據要專注的準確程度指標，RMSE 或 MAE，查詢 best_params。

cues.en: So, then we can create a new SVD model using the best parameters and do more interesting things with it.
cues.zh: 接著，就能使用最佳參數建立新的 SVD 模型，做更有意思的事。
